known_facts_book1: Dorothy's old friend from Oz, stuffed with straw, who rides behind Ozma's chariot on the Sawhorse.
Reads the sign on Langwidere's palace door and is the first of the Oz party Dorothy calls to from her tower.
Proud of the brains the great Wizard of Oz gave him, and afraid of the Nome King's furnaces because a single spark could burn him up.
Guesses wrongly in the palace and is transformed into a solid gold card-receiver, then restored by Billina.
Collects Billina's eggs in his jacket pockets and hurls two of them into the Nome King's eyes, blinding him.
Proposes threatening the King with being turned into a goose-egg to force him to fetch the Tin Woodman.
Commands the army in the Tin Woodman's absence and rides back to the Emerald City in triumph.
Was once driven from the Emerald City throne by Jinjur's army of women.

known_relations_book1.Dorothy: His beloved little friend, whom he greets with a close embrace.
known_relations_book1.Tin Woodman: His dearest old comrade, whose loss as an ornament grieves him deeply.
known_relations_book1.Nome King: His adversary, whom he blinds with Billina's eggs to win the fight.
known_relations_book1.Billina: The yellow hen whose eggs he carries and throws to defeat the Nome King.
known_relations_book1.Ozma: The Ruler of Oz he advises during the expedition.

known_facts_book1: Dorothy's old friend from Oz, a man of tin who was born a real man named Nick Chopper and got his tin body a piece at a time.
Marches on foot as commander of Ozma's army of twenty-seven soldiers, his axe over his shoulder.
Boasts his army has eight generals, six colonels, seven majors, five captains and a single private.
Claims the privilege of following Ozma into the palace and is transformed into a green tin whistle shaped like a pig.
Little Prince Evring pockets the whistle, which is why neither the Nome King nor the magic belt can find the Tin Woodman.
Is disenchanted at last when Billina touches the whistle and says 'Ev', restoring him on the road back to Ev.
Is given a new diamond-studded axe at the Emerald City feast.

known_relations_book1.Scarecrow: His dearest old comrade, reunited joyfully after his recovery.

known_relations_book1.Nome King: His captor, who transforms him into a whistle and laughs at him as the funniest ornament.
known_relations_book1.Evring: The little Prince who unknowingly carries the whistle he was transformed into.

known_facts_book1: Dorothy's old friend, who now draws Ozma's golden chariot shoulder to shoulder with the Hungry Tiger.
Wears a big bow of blue ribbon between his ears.
Ruled the great forest as King of Beasts and journeyed to the Emerald City after Ozma became reigning princess, bringing his friend the Hungry Tiger.
Admits he is as cowardly as ever and has never been in danger without being afraid.
Leaps under the iron giant's hammer carrying Ozma, and makes twelve daring passages to carry the terrified officers across.
Guards Dorothy in the Nome King's throne room, snarling to keep the warriors back.

known_facts_book1: A new friend of the Cowardly Lion, an immense Tiger who draws Ozma's chariot beside him and wears a red ribbon on his tail.
Always hungry, with an appetite too large for his body; he longs to eat a fat baby but his conscience forbids it.
Says he is a good beast but a disgracefully bad tiger for refusing to eat harmless creatures, which is why he left the forest.
Repeatedly threatens to eat Billina, Nanda, and even Dorothy in jest, but never does.
Leaps under the iron giant's hammer carrying Dorothy on his back.
At the Emerald City feast eats everything and declares he has, somehow, actually lost his appetite.
